name: toolshed
description: A personal Claude Code plugin marketplace. Publishes orchestrate-issues (drive a GitHub issue dependency graph to completion with background agents). The doc-lifecycle plugin is paused; its source is retained for later repair.

plugins.name: orchestrate-issues
plugins.description: Drive a GitHub issue dependency graph to completion with background agents: dispatch an implementer per unblocked issue into its own worktree, spec-review each PR, land it, and re-query as merges open new edges.
